text:
maria.k: ok folks — finalizing the benchmark narrative for the webinar. need a crisp 2-line opener and 3 chart ideas. target: dev/platform teams + mid-market.
ashwin.g: love that. can we split the opener into a latency story and an econ story? one slide for each. :white_check_mark:
jordan_pm: +1. latency story = "predictable low tail latency". econ story = "tokens → dollars: how batching/quantization changes unit cost". short, punchy.
sam.design: on charts — propose: 1) scatter: latency (p50/p95) vs cost per 1M tokens across model variants; 2) stacked bar: cost breakdown (compute / infra / overhead) per throughput profile; 3) flow diagram: routing policy that trades cost for latency. will mock.
maria.k: perfect. also want one quick snippet that non-engineers can read in the slide notes. e.g., "choose fastpath models when latency matters; route to quantized variants for bulk embeddings to cut cost by X".
nashwin.g: can we quantify X with real numbers? we should show a small table: baseline -> 1.0x, quantized -> 0.35x cost at same throughput. if we can't, say "~60% cost reduction in common workloads" and footnote source.
jordan_pm: we have bench numbers from last quarter. here's the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/bench-q4 (placeholder). use sample workload: chat (short-turn), embeddings (high throughput), and reranking (memory heavy).
sam.design: copy. for the scatter, do we annotate per-slice: "PLG apps", "internal tools", "enterprise batch"? that will help routing narrative.
maria.k: yes — slices = PLG (latency-first), Internal (cost + reliability), Enterprise (SLA + private). each slice maps to a recommended config + CTA.
nashwin.g: inbound routing ask: webinar signups get segmented by slice via the registration form. PLG -> trial credits + quickstart; Enterprise -> SDR follow-up + dedicated case study. can ops-bot attach an event tag? @ops-bot any constraints?
ops-bot: tagging ok. will emit registration.event with property "workload_slice". requires the registration form to include a single-choice field.
jordan_pm: good. on messaging: headline options — A) "Latency when it matters. Cost when it counts." B) "Predictable inference economics at production scale." vote?
maria.k: lean A for social creative, B for slide deck headline. keep both in assets.
sam.design: timeline — I can do initial mocks by Tue EOD, final by Fri. will include alt headline treatments and color-safe charts.
nashwin.g: can we add a 1-paragraph blog that expands the charts for SEO? i'll draft. assign to me.
maria.k: tasks: sam — mocks; jordan — slide notes + chart data; ashwin — blog draft + funnel copy; ops-bot — registration tag. i'll assemble the webinar script. checkins Wed morning.
jordan_pm: pushing bench CSV to the sheet now. also adding short code snippet for the appendix that shows routing policy sample: ```json
{"route": [{"slice":"plg","model":"fast-v1","fallback":"fast-qint8"}]}```
maria.k: this is gold. last ask — one short quote from engineering about kernel/quantization impact. @ashwin.g can you pull from infra?
nashwin.g: pinging @eng-runtime for a 1-sentence quote. will paste when they reply.
maria.k: thanks everyone — momentum. :rocket:
